import bpy,json
from mathutils import Vector
ns=bpy.app.driver_namespace['setback16'];craft=ns['craft'];bank=ns['bank'];base=ns['baseheight'];tree=ns['ground_tree'];report=[]
for i in range(2):
 o=craft.objects['Combined_front_A outer steps'+('' if i==0 else '.001')];samples=[]
 for x in [4.48+i*.37+.015,4.48+i*.37+.355]:
  for y in [-3.70,-3.15,-2.60]:
   hit=tree.ray_cast(Vector((x,y,9)),Vector((0,0,-1)),20)[0];ground=max(base(x,y),hit.z if hit else -999)
   # Find the actual stone surface from below to identify bearing gaps.
   from mathutils.bvhtree import BVHTree
   st=BVHTree.FromPolygons([o.matrix_world@v.co for v in o.data.vertices],[list(p.vertices) for p in o.data.polygons])
   bottom=st.ray_cast(Vector((x,y,-2)),Vector((0,0,1)),10)[0]
   if bottom:samples.append({'xy':[x,y],'bottom':bottom.z,'ground':ground,'gap':bottom.z-ground})
 report.append({'step':i,'samples':samples})
(ns['cap']/'tread_support_probe.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2),encoding='utf8')
print('TREAD_SUPPORT',report)
